findings.highlight: The boy who was her master...ended his own life while trying to protect her.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女の主だった少年は、守ろうとした彼女自身の手で、その命を終えていた。
findings.governingReading: 彼女自身の手で names her own hand as the cause of his death; 守ろうとした modifies that protecting woman. The next paragraph says she prioritized the boy after the momentary Grail wish.
findings.explanation: Saber killing the boy she tried to protect becomes the boy ending his life to protect her.
